sample_narratives.issue: Dealing with your lender or servicer
sample_narratives.text:
I am submitting this complaint regarding the servicing and balance calculation of my private student loan, which was originally serviced by Navient and is now serviced by XXXX. 

My concern is that the loan balance does not appear to accurately reflect my repayment history and that interest capitalization significantly increased my repayment obligation. 

During the period when I was enrolled in school, my loan was placed into an in-school forbearance status. I was not made aware that interest would continue to accrue during this period or that unpaid interest could later be capitalized and ad…

summary: Between 2025-03-07 and 2026-09-07, the CFPB published 1,200 complaints about Navient. Volume is rising (last 3 months averaged 340 per month versus 60 before). The most common issue is "Dealing with your lender or servicer" (52% of complaints), concentrated in student loan. The company responded on time to 100% of cases; 100% of closed cases ended without relief. Overall risk signal: Elevated (64/100). This is an exploratory signal from public complaint data, not a regulatory, legal, or investment conclusion.

regulatory.note: Live public-record cross-reference from FDIC BankFind, SEC EDGAR, GLEIF, and Federal Reserve enforcement actions. Public records only — not a verdict.
